title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 constraints for KMS key usage to enforce region residency policies and provide stronger audit trails for all key operations. This change implements enforcement and audit-log hardening for KMS region pinning (policy-level) and adds migration tooling + feature-flag rollout to avoid a global blast radius. Summary of changes: - Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 evaluation path: new policy checks in pkg/rbac/v2/enforcer.go that validate requested KMS region against resource residency attributes and team-level allowances. - Audit logging: emit structured audit events for KMS-related policy decisions (allow/deny/override) with key metadata (key_id, region, requester, policy_id, decision_reason). Events are emitted to the existing audit pipeline and include a new event type `kms_region_pin_decision`. - Migration tooling: cmd/migrations/migrate_kms_residency.go adds a migration to backfill residency attributes based on existing KMS key tags and cloud metadata with a dry-run mode. - Config and feature flags: new feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce` (default: off) and staged rollout helper in infra/featureflags for ramping to 100%. - Tests & CI: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration test that runs against the local audit sink, and an e2e scenario that exercises deny+fallback behavior when region mismatch occurs. - Docs & release notes: updated docs/security/rbac-v2.md and operations runbook for incident response related to KMS enforcement. Rollout plan: 1) merge behind feature flag with enforcement off and audit enabled for 1 week 2) enable audit-only enforcement for a small percentage of traffic (2%) to surface false positives 3) enable enforcement gradually (canary groups, 10%/50%/100%) with rollback path. Migration: run migration in dry-run to collect keys without residency attributes, review results, then run with --apply during a maintenance window. Backwards compatibility: we added a configurable override role (`kms.region.bypass`) which can be granted to platform SREs for emergency operations; this is tightly logged and gated by additional approval. Security review/approvals: SEC review completed and minor feedback addressed around log scrubbing for PII (no sensitive plaintext logged). Checklist: - [x] Policy enforcement implemented - [x] Structured audit events emitted - [x] Migration tool added (dry-run) - [x] Unit + integration + e2e tests - [x] Feature flag + staged rollout configured - [x] Docs + runbook updates - [x] Security review done Testing notes: Flaky integration test `TestAuditSinkBatching` was observed on CI and was retried; fixed by adding a 100ms backoff in the test harness. Performance impact: policy evaluation adds ~0.8ms median to request path for RBAC checks that touch KMS metadata; we added a short-circuit cache for repeated key lookups to keep p95 impact < 2ms. Migration safety: migration job has a concurrency limit and rate limiter so it won't overwhelm control-plane rate limits. See release_notes for operator-facing notes.

review_comments: Connor Lee: Please add a short-circuit cache for repeated key region lookups; this is required to keep p95 latency acceptable. (resolved)
Elena Martinez: The audit event currently includes key ARN; redact account IDs per policy and only send obfuscated identifiers. (addressed)
Zoe Kim: Can we add a feature flag and staged rollout plan? Also add a migration dry-run mode so operators can validate. (added)
Connor Lee: Approving once tests pass and we have the staged rollout documented. (approved)
Asha Patel: Thanks, addressed cache + redaction + added rollout steps in the PR description and ops runbook. CI flake fixed by increasing timeout on TestAuditSinkBatching.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 with structured audit events. Feature rolled out behind 'rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce' feature flag. Migration tooling added to backfill residency attributes. Operators: run migration in dry-run, review results, then apply during a maintenance window. Emergency override role 'kms.region.bypass' exists but is tightly audited.
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/2025-11 needed for on-prem customers. Backport should disable enforcement by default and include migration tool. Coordinate with infra for terraform module changes.
security_review: SEC team reviewed; required log scrubbing applied and no plaintext sensitive fields emitted. Approved 2025-11-10 by SEC-Eng rotation.
operational_impact: Small added latency on RBAC checks (~0.8ms median). Migration operates with rate limits and concurrency caps. Audit volume increases by ~0.3% due to additional structured events.
migration_instructions: 1) Checkout branch and run ./cmd/migrations/migrate_kms_residency --dry-run --output=report.json 2) Inspect report.json for missing residency attributes and potential conflicts 3) Coordinate maintenance window and run with --apply and a low concurrency flag 4) Monitor audit sink and error dashboards; rollback by revoking enforcement via featureflag
acknowledgements: Thanks to infra (Elena Martinez) for audit sink updates, platform SREs for migration runbook review, and SEC team for the security review.
